extracted.name: Bing Cherry Congealed Salad
extracted.description: Canned fruit and chopped nuts are folded into a creamy gelatin base in this cold salad.
ingredient_lines: 1 (16.5 ounce) can pitted Bing cherries, drained, juice reserved
1 (15 ounce) can crushed pineapple, drained with juice reserved
instruction_lines: Combine reserved cherry juice and pineapple juice in a saucepan to make 1 cup. Bring to a boil. Add gelatin and whisk until dissolved. Remove from the heat, add cream cheese, and whisk until smooth.
Add cola and beat until mixture becomes fluffy. Fold in cherries, pineapple, and nuts. Pour into molded container, chill 6 to 8 hours or until firm.
